statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate syncopal events with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I25.10
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The service is excluded from the patient's current coverage
